Совещание перестаёт быть разговором, пос: A meeting stops being a talk that leaves nothing behind. Decisions and assignments are recorded in the meeting card: an assignment immediately becomes a task with an assignee and a due date, and the assignee gets a notification.
Вкладка «Решения» — общий реестр приняты: The “Decisions” tab is the common register of the project’s decisions, “Assignments” is everything issued at meetings that is not done yet. A meeting can be recorded as audio: the system will transcribe it and suggest a draft of the minutes.
Система сама, каждые два часа, проверяет: The system checks the project by itself every two hours and raises “flags” where something goes wrong: a task has been blocked for over a day, work on the critical path is overdue, there has been no fresh progress record for long, the weekly plan is performing badly, a milestone has slipped, dangerous weather is expected for the next days.
У каждого сигнала есть важность и объясн: Each signal has an importance and an explanation: what happened and based on which figures. From a signal you can create a task, add it to a meeting agenda or assign someone responsible. When the cause is gone, the signal closes by itself. The health index at the top is the overall rating of the project.
Мастера и прорабы записывают обязательст: Foremen and masters write down commitments: what each crew undertakes to do this week. At the end of the week they mark each item: done or not, and if not, why.
Из итогов считается процент выполнения п: The results give the plan completion percentage (PPC): what share of what was promised was really done. The “Plan performance” tab shows how it changes and which reasons disrupt the work most often.
Риск — то, что ещё не случилось, но може: A risk is something that has not happened yet but may disrupt the schedule or budget: a delayed delivery, a failed approval, bad weather. For each one the probability and the impact are rated from 1 to 5; their product is the risk score.
